drivers: Requires understanding expected value concept and subtracting the cost; many adults confuse expected winnings (100) with profit
Arithmetic is simple (20% of 500 = 100; 100 - 83 = 17) and generous 140 s time limit
Distractors capture common errors: 100 (forgot cost), 417 (500-83), -83 (loss case)
4-option format gives 25% floor and partial elimination helps guessers
